tuning.description: A fast crystalline bolt. Each hit shatters into starlight.
Launch a white-hot lance with an ember wake.
A radiant spear that pierces up to two targets.
Release an expanding flame ring around yourself.
Restore 180 health after a committed healing cast.
Hold to channel a prismatic ray for up to 2 seconds. One use; damages the first target.
Enchant the opposite-hand weapon with 35 bonus magic damage for 15 seconds. Cycling preserves the enchantment.
Hold to pour flames into a forward fan for up to 2 seconds. One use per channel.
Send a broad lunar crescent through enemies, striking each once.
Place a field of embers. Activates after 0.3 seconds and burns enemies every half-second for 6 seconds.
Strike a selected enemy with lightning that jumps to three more visible targets, losing 20% damage each jump.
Arm four orbiting shards for 12 seconds. B or touch Command fires a homing volley without spending another use.
Place a rune that arms after 0.6 seconds. An approaching enemy triggers an explosive magic burst.
Call six stars onto a selected region. Ground seals mark the exact impact locations.
Summon a vulnerable mobile wisp for 12 seconds. It follows you and fires holy bolts at enemies.
Carry a healing sanctuary for 6 seconds, restoring 15 health every half-second to you and nearby allies.
Surge forward as a comet, striking crossed enemies once. Stops at walls and grants no invulnerability.
Hold a soul tether on a selected enemy for 2 seconds. Completing it deals a final burst; breaking range or sight severs it.
